description: Get credit rating history for an NZX company. Shows S&P, Moody's, Fitch, AM Best ratings with upgrades, downgrades, and outlook changes. ~20 NZX companies have credit ratings.

action.description: Filter by action: affirmed, upgraded, downgraded, assigned, withdrawn

name: get_credit_ratings

data.description: The tool payload. Null when the call did not produce one — read meta.availability_status to find out why, and do not treat null as zero, empty or "none found".

availability_status.description: ok: complete payload. truncated: payload exceeded the transport cap and was cut. parse_failed: payload is text this server could not parse as JSON. error: the tool raised.

encoding.description: toon = pipe-delimited tabular encoding; header row names the columns.

provenance.description: Whether the figures can cite a source document. "undeclared" means no claim has been made for this endpoint yet — it is not a claim that the data is unsourced.

retrieved_at.description: When this platform produced the answer — NOT the as-at date of the data.

schema_version.description: Envelope contract version. Bumps only on a breaking shape change.
